breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and periodic. The agent correctly identified this conflict and removed the incorrect periodic condition, specifying only 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u = 0 on all four edges.' This aligns perfectly with the ground truth, which also removed the periodic condition.
